blocks.html:
Structures occupied for purposes involving explosion hazards shall be provided with explosion control in compliance with rules of the Commissioner of the Fire Department. Explosion control systems shall be designed and installed in accordance with the New York City Fire Code. 
Section MC 311: Smoke and Heat Vents
